title: content-addressed language provider watchdog

claim.to_prove: A language provider can be observed, quarantined, rolled back, and probed by artifact digest without entering Taiji cognition or inventing a readable answer.
claim.must_not_claim: Provider health is not language intelligence, planning, tool choice, or a replacement for Taiji state.

owner.state_owner: Taiji native language-provider health state and artifact registry

sources: timeout, load, validation, digest-drift, and canary outcomes

output.type: versioned provider health transition and LanguageProviderStatus projection

trace.privacy: Persist identifiers, reason codes, counters, and revisions; do not persist prompt or response content unless an explicit diagnostic artifact owns it.
trace.determinism: Same artifact digest, policy revision, event sequence, and clock fixture must produce the same transition trace.

limits: bounded probe count per cooldown window
one active transition at a time

checkpoint.continuation: After restore, the next probe/rollback decision must preserve the same state lineage and artifact binding.

red_proof: one failure immediately flips to healthy
evidence.holdout: Use an artifact digest and failure sequence not present in the controller fixtures; holdout must not mutate provider registry evidence.
evidence.lesion: Remove health observation, previous-artifact binding, or native fallback one at a time; the corresponding safety property must fail closed.
evidence.cross_seed: Run deterministic controller traces across at least three seeds or equivalent independent event schedules before declaring the transition policy stable.

failure_isolation.provider_failure: Quarantine only the affected artifact digest; keep Taiji cognition and other registered artifacts intact.
failure_isolation.checkpoint_failure: Do not publish a rotation or rollback whose complete health state cannot be persisted.
failure_isolation.unknown_state: Return structured degraded/no-output status; never fabricate a natural-language answer.

rollback.path: restore parent native checkpoint, revoke the failed artifact from active selection, and append a reason-coded transition
rollback.atomicity: health state, registry selection, and provider status projection commit together or not at all
rollback.recovery: Only a fresh content-addressed canary may move quarantined -> probing -> healthy.

boundary: No provider API may select a tool, goal, plan, memory, or recovery branch.
No UI code may rotate a provider or infer health from human-readable text.
A native structured fallback is an explicit degraded output, not a successful provider response.
